verses.gurmukhi: ਮਉਲੇ ਅੰਬ ਬਸੰਤ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਉੜੀ ਅਕੁ ਸੁ ਫੁਲੀ ਭਰਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: maule a(n)b basa(n)t rut aauRee aku su fulee bhariaa|

en.bdb: In spring season, the mangoes blossom and akk the bitter wild plant of sandy region also becomes full of flowers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਖਖੜੀ ਅਕਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਅੰਬੁ ਅਫਰਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)b na lagai khakhaRee ak na lagai a(n)b afariaa|

en.bdb: The pod of akk cannot produce mango and fruitless akk cannot grow on mango tree.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੀ ਕੋਇਲ ਅੰਬ ਵਣਿ ਅਕਿਤਿਡੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਮਿਤਾਲਾ ਹਰਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: kaalee koil a(n)b van akitidd chit mitaalaa hariaa|

en.bdb: Nightingale sitting on mango tree is black and the grosshopper of akk is speckled one or green.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਬਿਰਖ ਭੇਦੁ ਸੰਗ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਧਰਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: man pa(n)kheroo birakh bhedh sa(n)g subhaau soiee fal dhariaa|

en.bdb: Mind is a bird and due to difference of the results of different company, it gets the fruit of the tree it chooses to sit upon.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਡਰਦਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਸਾਧ ਨ ਡਰਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmat ddaradhaa saadhasa(n)g dhuramat sa(n)g asaadh na ddariaa|

en.bdb: Mind is scared of holy congregation and the wisdom of the Guru but is not afraid of evil company and evil intellect i.e. it does not want to go in good company and takes interest in the evil company.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਭੀ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat vachhal bhee aakheeaai patit udhaaran patit udhariaa|

en.bdb: God is said to be loving towards saints and liberator of the fallen ones.
He has salvaged many fallen pepole and only he gets across who is accepted by Him.
